title: Customer Success - Q4 Retrospective
summary: Reviewed top customer issues from Q4. Major themes: onboarding friction, API documentation gaps, and slow support response times. NPS improved from 42 to 51.
decisions: Support SLA: <4 hours for P1, <24 hours for P2
Onboarding checklist to be built for all new customers
Monthly customer feedback sessions to continue
transcription: [14:00] Sarah Chen: Q4 retrospective on customer success. Emma, let's start with the numbers. [14:03] Emma Liu: NPS up from 42 to 51. Support tickets down 15%. But onboarding complaints up 30%. [14:08] David Kim: What's driving the onboarding issues? [14:10] Emma Liu: API documentation is the main blocker. Customers can't find what they need. [14:14] Alex Rivera: I reviewed the docs last week. They're outdated and poorly organized. [14:18] Jen Park: We need a complete rewrite. Not just updates. [14:21] Sarah Chen: Agreed. Timeline? [14:23] Jen Park: 4 weeks for initial overhaul. But we need a dedicated technical writer. [14:27] David Kim: Approved. Post the role this week. [14:30] Emma Liu: Support response times also need work. We're averaging 6 hours for P1. [14:34] Sarah Chen: Target should be 4 hours. What's the bottleneck? [14:37] Emma Liu: On-call engineer availability. We need better escalation procedures.

risks.description: Technical writer hiring may take longer than expected
API doc rewrite may delay other Q1 commitments
